value.body: Some central ministries, defence and security organisations need people who can translate or interpret foreign languages. These posts are filled through occasional, post-by-post notifications rather than a regular annual exam.

items.label: How posts are notified
items.note: Through UPSC recruitment notices or the organisation's own advertisement

items.label: Usual qualification
items.note: Often a degree or Master's in the language; some posts ask for experience

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Build certified proficiency and a degree in the language, then watch UPSC recruitment notices and ministry advertisements. Selection is usually by written test and/or interview in the language.

value.title: At a glance
items: Openings are few and unpredictable; most language graduates also prepare for other exams.
Some posts carry security clearance or nationality conditions.
Experience in translation or interpretation strengthens an application.
